name: web_openim_bridge
description: Builds the browser OpenIM WASM bridge for Flutter Web

scripts.build: esbuild src/openim_bridge.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --outfile=../web/openim_bridge.js && cp node_modules/@openim/wasm-client-sdk/assets/openIM.wasm ../web/openIM.wasm && cp node_modules/@openim/wasm-client-sdk/assets/sql-wasm.wasm ../web/sql-wasm.wasm && cp node_modules/@openim/wasm-client-sdk/assets/wasm_exec.js ../web/wasm_exec.js && cp node_modules/@openim/wasm-client-sdk/lib/worker.js ../web/worker.js && cp node_modules/@openim/wasm-client-sdk/lib/worker-legacy.js ../web/worker-legacy.js
